title: AUTH-067 missed acquisition does not replay

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A expires at controlled time T+900 seconds; no refresh credential exists
4. And the page became hidden before T+875 seconds; hide acquisition failed
5. And request counts restart after that failed acquisition
6. When the controlled browser clock reaches T+890 seconds
7. And the browser changes this page from hidden to visible
8. And the controlled browser clock reaches T+900 seconds
9. And the controlled browser clock advances through the 1000-millisecond logout delay
10. Then the browser records exactly 0 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/refreshtoken"
11. And the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" on the login page is visible
12. And the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" on the login page is visible
13. And the button labelled "Sign In" on the login page is visible
14. And the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is absent
15. And the browser records exactly 0 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/relogin"

annotations.description: Actual MFE; controlled API responses, clock, visibility and suspension adapters. Unsigned browser-only credentials. No natural lifecycle, real identity or service policy acceptance.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
